manifest.description: Lift a method subset from a struct's inherent impl into a trait + impl Trait for Struct, optionally migrating call sites to depend on the trait.
when_to_use: a struct exposes a public method surface callers should depend on by trait, not concretion
operator wants mockability for a subset of methods
preparing for dyn-dispatch or generic-parameter binding at call sites
anti_patterns: do not use when methods take Self by value or return Self - the trait cannot be used as dyn Trait when dyn_compatible=false
do not use when methods call other inherent non-selected methods on self - the transform can refuse with extract_trait_orphaned_call
do not use on non-Rust files

call_site_replacement.description: Replacement type used at call sites when migrate_call_sites=true (e.g. "Arc<dyn MyTrait>" or "impl MyTrait").
